# glasstec 2026


## Oct 20 to 23
Düsseldorf, Germany
Booth #12E32


## Optimize Glass Temperatures


### Power Precise Coatings


Glass manufacturers are under pressure to improve efficiency, consistency, and product quality. AE brings decades of expertise in glass production and thin-film coating applications, supported by global field applications and service teams. Stop by our booth to explore proven solutions, including a live temperature measurement demo and an exclusive preview of our new power control technology.


**Why meet with AE at Glasstec?**


**For glass coaters:** Explore plasma power technologies designed to improve coating quality, deposition stability, uptime, and process flexibility. Tell us more about what coating materials are giving you power-delivery or arc-management challenges.


**For glass producers:** Discover how precise temperature measurement, power control, and process visibility can help improve glass quality, energy efficiency, and production consistency. Tell us more about where temperature variability, energy use, or aging assets are limiting your quality or throughput.


**For operations teams:** Learn how calibration, repair, refurbishment, upgrades, and technical support can help reduce downtime, extend asset life, and keep critical production systems operating reliably. Tell us more about how your systems are experiencing downtime, troubleshooting effort, or calibration risk.
